candidates.hook: Mother bursts into the cabin holding a lantern and screams "Alexander!" as the camera reveals Alexander alive.
candidates.cliffhanger: Alexander says "I wasn't supposed to," leaving the reason for his survival unanswered.
candidates.why: A dramatic reunion hook grabs attention, then a mystery about his survival forces viewers to watch the full episode.

candidates.hook: Alexander whispers "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead," a shocking revelation about a hidden conspiracy.
candidates.cliffhanger: He drops the bombshell "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now," cutting before his mother's horrified gasp.
candidates.why: A concise, high‑stakes conspiracy reveal hooks viewers and ends on a chilling unanswered question.

candidates.hook: Alexander's mother, breathless, declares "I will not die in that house," as she struggles through the dark tunnel.
candidates.cliffhanger: She reaches the frozen cabin door and whispers "This must be the place," cutting before the door is opened.
candidates.why: A desperate escape hook pulls the thumb, and the unknown of what lies behind the cabin door creates tension.

moments.desc: Mother declares "I will not die in that house," establishing her resolve.
Mother steps into the cabin, lantern raised, and sees Alexander for the first time.
Alexander reveals the lie: "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
He names the conspirators: "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now," before the mother's reaction.
